description: A sudden loess collapse struck a village in Hongtong County in the city of Linfen in north China's Shanxi Province, located on the Loess Plateau, on Friday evening. A house was buried as a result of the collapse, killing five people and injuring three others, according to county-level emergency response authorities. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | 5 killed, 3 injured after house buried by loess collapse in north China

author: New China TV
description: Mile City in southwest China's Yunnan Province is using 56 AI-powered drones to strengthen flood prevention. Operating around the clock, the drones provide full coverage of flood-prone areas and can reach potential hazard sites within five minutes during heavy rain. The low-altitude technology is improving real-time monitoring, hazard detection and emergency response, making flood control smarter and more efficient.
title: AI Drones Boost Smart Flood Defense in Southwest China

author: New China TV
description: At just 19, #Qinqiang opera performer Song Zhengyang has mastered the breathtaking "Head Lamp" stunt. The skill, featured in the classic Qinqiang play The Head Lamp, requires balancing a lit lamp on the head without touching it throughout the performance. He began training at age 12 and has practiced without interruption for seven years. To perfect the stunt, he has kept his hair shaved since childhood, developing extraordinary control over his scalp muscles -- even to the point where his forehead moves with his eyebrows.
title: Chinese Mastery in Qinqiang Opera | How the "head lamp" stunt is mastered
